title: Knowledge Tree Node
description: A single typed node in the Faros-case knowledge tree. Stored as YAML frontmatter in a Markdown file; the body is human-readable detail. Agents may create nodes only with status='proposed'; only a human sets status='approved'.

parent.description: ID of the parent node. The single root node 'organization:root' has parent 'null'.

provenance.description: sourced = from a cited Faros page/doc; inferred = our labelled reasoning; user-intent = a want stated by the human.

status.description: Agents write 'proposed'. Only a human writes 'approved' or 'rejected'. Advisors answer ONLY from 'approved'.

quote_or_derivation.description: Short paraphrase or <15-word quote; what in the source supports this node.

honesty.description: For faros/mapping nodes: is the capability live today, on the roadmap, or our inference? Advisors must surface this.

fields.description: Type-specific structured fields. Validated per-type by the application layer; kept open here.

approved_by.description: Human who approved (set only with status='approved').

proposed_by.description: Agent or surface that proposed the node, e.g. 'curator-agent', 'claude-web'.
